blocks.html: When a Special Scenic View District is designated on a public park or portion thereof, any future landscaping, erection of new signs or buildings or other structures, thereon, shall not penetrate a view plane unless authorized by the City Planning Commission. As a condition for such authorization, the Commission shall find that any penetration of a view plane shall not significantly obstruct the scenic view which is to be protected by the provisions of this Chapter.
blocks.plainText: When a Special Scenic View District is designated on a public park or portion thereof, any future landscaping, erection of new signs or buildings or other structures, thereon, shall not penetrate a view plane unless authorized by the City Planning Commission. As a condition for such authorization, the Commission shall find that any penetration of a view plane shall not significantly obstruct the scenic view which is to be protected by the provisions of this Chapter.
